- The Everything App for Work: Replace multiple tools with a single, unified platform.
- AI at the Core: Assist organizations in streamlining workflows and enhancing productivity with cutting-edge AI.
- Massive Market Opportunity: Engage with a broad total addressable market across various industries and company sizes.
- High-Growth Environment: Join one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies that is shaping the future of work.
- Impact-Driven Sales: Provide measurable ROI by addressing real business challenges.
- World-Class Culture: Collaborate with innovative, driven, and customer-focused teammates.

If you are interested or know someone who would be a great fit, please DM me.

$300M ARR - A Milestone Worth Celebrating

Hitting $300 million ARR is more than just a number - it’s a moment to pause and reflect on how far we’ve come as a team, a company, and a community of customers and partners.

Take a few minutes to check out this video of our CFO, Dan Zhang, sharing what Converged AI means and how ClickUp is leading the charge: https://lnkd.in/ede3Hpn2

This milestone is proof that we’ve built something that scales - not just in revenue, but in trust and impact.

It’s a reminder that sustainable growth comes from staying disciplined, focused, and customer-first.

And it’s motivation to keep pushing - because milestones are not finish lines, they’re launch pads.
